description: Extensive question bank on Indian Constitution and Public Administration derived from the provided FDA & SDA examination notes. questions.subject: Indian Constitution
questions.question: Which Act is generally regarded as the first major step towards parliamentary control over the East India Company's administration?
questions.explanation: The Regulating Act of 1773 is generally regarded as the first major step towards parliamentary control over the East India Company's administration.

questions.subject: Indian Constitution
questions.question: Which of the following changes was NOT introduced by the Regulating Act of 1773?

options.A: It made the Governor of Bengal the Governor-General of Bengal
options.B: It created an Executive Council of four members to assist the Governor-General
options.C: It established a Supreme Court at Calcutta
options.D: It ended the East India Company's trade monopoly in India

questions.explanation: The Regulating Act of 1773 made the Governor of Bengal the Governor-General of Bengal, created an Executive Council of four members, subordinated the Presidencies of Bombay and Madras to Bengal, and provided for a Supreme Court at Calcutta. Ending the Company's trade monopoly was done by the Charter Act of 1813.

questions.subject: Indian Constitution
questions.question: Who was the first Governor-General of Bengal under the Regulating Act of 1773?
questions.explanation: Warren Hastings was the first Governor-General of Bengal under the Regulating Act of 1773.

questions.subject: Indian Constitution
questions.question: When was the Supreme Court at Fort William, Calcutta, established under the Regulating Act?
questions.explanation: The Supreme Court at Fort William, Calcutta, was established in 1774 under the Regulating Act.

questions.subject: Indian Constitution
questions.question: Who was the first Chief Justice of the Supreme Court at Calcutta?
questions.explanation: Sir Elijah Impey was the first Chief Justice of the Supreme Court at Calcutta.

questions.subject: Indian Constitution
questions.question: Which Act established the dual system of control over the Company's civil, military and revenue affairs?
questions.explanation: Pitt's India Act, 1784, established the dual system of control over the Company's civil, military and revenue affairs.

questions.subject: Indian Constitution
questions.question: What was the significance of Pitt's India Act, 1784?

options.A: It ended the East India Company's trade monopoly in India
options.B: It distinguished the Company's commercial functions from its political functions and established a Board of Control
options.C: It made the Governor-General of Bengal the Governor-General of India
options.D: It introduced separate electorates for Muslims

questions.explanation: Pitt's India Act, 1784, distinguished the Company's commercial functions from its political functions and established a Board of Control to supervise political affairs, while the Court of Directors continued to manage commercial affairs.

questions.subject: Indian Constitution
questions.question: Which Act was the first to use the term 'Governor-General of Bengal' in the constitutional framework?
questions.explanation: The Regulating Act of 1773 was the first to use the term 'Governor-General of Bengal' in the constitutional framework.

questions.subject: Indian Constitution
questions.question: Which Charter Act ended the East India Company's trade monopoly in India, except for tea and trade with China?
questions.explanation: The Charter Act of 1813 ended the East India Company's trade monopoly in India, except for tea and trade with China.

questions.subject: Indian Constitution
questions.question: What was the importance of the Charter Act of 1813 for education?

options.A: It established the first university in India
options.B: It provided an annual sum of one lakh rupees for the promotion of education in India
options.C: It made education a fundamental right

questions.subject: Indian Constitution
questions.question: Which Charter Act made the Governor-General of Bengal the Governor-General of India?
questions.explanation: The Charter Act of 1833 made the Governor-General of Bengal the Governor-General of India.

questions.subject: Indian Constitution
questions.question: Who was the first Governor-General of India under the Charter Act of 1833?
questions.explanation: Lord William Bentinck was the first Governor-General of India under the Charter Act of 1833.

questions.subject: Indian Constitution
questions.question: What was the major legislative change made by the Charter Act of 1833?

options.A: It introduced dyarchy in the provinces
options.B: It centralized legislative power in the Governor-General of India in Council and ended the legislative powers of the Bombay and Madras Presidencies
options.C: It introduced separate electorates for Muslims
options.D: It established a bicameral legislature at the Centre

questions.subject: Indian Constitution
questions.question: Which Charter Act ended the East India Company's commercial activities completely?
questions.explanation: The Charter Act of 1833 ended the East India Company's commercial activities completely.

questions.subject: Indian Constitution
questions.question: Which Charter Act separated the legislative and executive functions of the Governor-General's Council to a limited extent?
questions.explanation: The Charter Act of 1853 separated the legislative and executive functions of the Governor-General's Council to a limited extent.

questions.subject: Indian Constitution
questions.question: Which Act introduced open competition for recruitment to the civil services in principle?
questions.explanation: The Charter Act of 1853 introduced open competition for recruitment to the civil services in principle; implementation of competitive recruitment followed through subsequent measures.

questions.subject: Indian Constitution
questions.question: Which Act transferred the government of India from the East India Company to the British Crown?
questions.explanation: The Government of India Act, 1858, transferred the government of India from the East India Company to the British Crown.

questions.question: What was the immediate political background to the Government of India Act, 1858?

options.D: The formation of the Indian National Congress

questions.subject: Indian Constitution
questions.question: Who became the first Viceroy of India under the Crown administration?
questions.explanation: Lord Canning became the first Viceroy of India under the Crown administration.

questions.subject: Indian Constitution
questions.question: Which office replaced the Board of Control and Court of Directors after 1858?

questions.explanation: The Indian Councils Act, 1909, also known as the Morley-Minto Reforms, introduced separate electorates for Muslims for the first time.

questions.explanation: John Morley, the Secretary of State for India, and Lord Minto, the Viceroy of India, were associated with the Morley-Minto Reforms.

questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.subject: Indian Constitution
questions.question: Under the Government of India Act, 1919, what did dyarchy mean?

options.A: Division of legislative powers into federal, provincial and concurrent lists
options.B: Division of provincial subjects into reserved subjects administered by the Governor and his executive councillors, and transferred subjects administered by ministers responsible to the legislative council
options.C: Division of the executive into two branches at the Centre
options.D: Division of the judiciary from the executive

questions.explanation: Under the Government of India Act, 1919, dyarchy meant provincial subjects were divided into reserved subjects administered by the Governor and his executive councillors, and transferred subjects administered by ministers responsible to the legislative council.

questions.subject: Indian Constitution
questions.question: Which Act introduced a bicameral legislature at the Centre for the first time?
questions.explanation: The Government of India Act, 1919, introduced a bicameral legislature at the Centre for the first time.

questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.explanation: The Government of India Act, 1935, provided for the establishment of the Federal Public Service Commission and Provincial Public Service Commissions.

questions.question: Who was the Chairman of the Steering Committee of the Constituent Assembly?

questions.explanation: B. N. Rau, the Constitutional Adviser, prepared an initial draft and comparative constitutional study; the Drafting Committee revised and developed the text, which was debated and amended by the Constituent Assembly.

questions.subject: Indian Constitution
questions.question: When did Dr. B. R. Ambedkar introduce the Draft Constitution in the Constituent Assembly?
